title: 文章复盘 · 8题
meta: 2013 英语一 Section I 完形填空 · 本篇问题 4 题 + 历史弱项 4 题 · 全部使用迁移语境
footer: 本篇复盘结果只有在你点击“提交结果到 GitHub”并在 GitHub 再点 Submit new issue 后，才会进入后续间隔复习。

questions.q: The auditor would order an independent recount ______ two consecutive inventory checks reported exactly the same suspiciously low number of errors. Which connective fits the stated condition?
o: if
until
though
unless

exp.trans: 如果连续两次库存检查都报告了可疑地相同且极低的差错数，审计员就会要求独立复核。
exp.structure: The auditor would order是主句；if引导条件从句，说明什么情形会触发重新清点；consecutive修饰两次盘点。
exp.other: auditor 审计员；inventory 库存；recount 重新清点；suspiciously 可疑地。
exp.meaning: if表示触发后续行动的条件；until表示动作持续到某一时间点为止，不能代替此处的判断条件。
exp.rest: until会改变主句行为的时间边界；though只引出让步而非触发条件；unless表示若不发生该条件则行动，与所需逻辑相反。

questions.q:
The plumber thanked the neighbour. He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour.
哪句合并正确？
o: The plumber thanked the neighbour from that he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom from he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from him.

exp.trans: 水管工感谢了那位借梯子给他的邻居。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour. → 用whom替代重复的the neighbour：the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from → 把from前置：the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder。外层主干是The plumber + thanked + the neighbour，后接修饰neighbour的定语从句。
exp.other: plumber 水管工；neighbour 邻居；ladder 梯子；borrow A from B 从B那里借来A。
exp.meaning: from不是临时猜出来的，来自原句borrow...from...；先行词是人，介词后用whom。
exp.rest: from that：关系代词that不能直接置于介词后。whom from he：介词前置时必须是from whom，不是whom from。from him：关系代词whom已经代替该人，再保留him造成重复。

questions.target: who makes the decision / 谁决定录取
questions.q: The applicant chose which research group to approach, but an external panel decided whether to admit her. Which distinction is supported?
o: Both decisions were made by the panel.
Her admission was entirely within her own control.
Her choice of group was her decision; admission success depended on the panel.
The panel controlled which group she originally wanted to contact.

exp.trans: 申请者自行决定联系哪个研究组，但是否录取由外部评审委员会决定。她的选择与最终申请成功不是同一个主体作出的决定。
exp.structure: The applicant chose...与an external panel decided...构成两个并列且主语不同的分句；whether to admit her为委员会决定的内容。
exp.other: research group 研究组；external panel 外部评审委员会；admit 录取；approach 联系。
exp.meaning: 必须区分applicant's decision（申请者自己的选择）与applicant's success（由他人评估后能否成功获准），不能仅凭同一个applicant归为同一行为。
exp.rest: 录取不由申请者单独控制；研究组选择由她本人做出；把两个行为都交给委员会或认为录取完全在本人控制下，都忽视了主语切换。

questions.target: 具体反对行动支持哪条主旨
questions.skill: 例子→论点 / 不能多推态度变化
questions.q: A city report says proposals to digitize building permits have repeatedly stalled because established interests resist change. It cites a builders' association that organized petitions and delayed the new system for six months. What does the example mainly illustrate?
o: Organized groups can impede administrative reforms.
The association persuaded every resident to change political allegiance.
Most builders oppose the current political system in all circumstances.
Digital permits always cost more than paper applications.

exp.trans: 城市报告说，建筑许可数字化改革屡次被既有利益团体阻挠，并举建筑协会组织请愿、使新系统推迟六个月的例子。例子说明利益团体可能阻碍行政改革。
exp.structure: 主句proposals ... have stalled because...提出上层论点；It cites an association ...是作为证据的例子；organized petitions / delayed是例子中的行为与结果。
exp.other: digitize 数字化；permit 许可证；established interests 既有利益集团；administrative reform 行政改革。
exp.meaning: 例证题先找例子附近作者要证明的论点：改革遭遇阻力。组织请愿不等于改变公众政治立场；反对一项改革也不等于反对整个政治制度。
exp.rest: 政治归属改变需要前后态度证据；所有情况下反对现行政治制度扩大对象与频率；数字许可成本并未涉及。

questions.target: 单次发现 vs 跨来源确认
questions.skill: 过程终点与条件的角色识别
questions.q: A driver first reports cracks on a bridge, but the warning is not issued to the whole region until engineers compare photographs, inspect the structure, and confirm the hazard. What is required for the initial report to become an official warning?
o: A more vivid description from the first driver.
Agreement that the first driver deserves public credit.
Public enthusiasm for an alarming photograph.
Independent assessment and confirmation of the reported danger.

exp.trans: 司机最先报告桥面裂缝，但直到工程师比对照片、检查结构并确认危险，地区警报才正式发布。
exp.structure: A driver + reports + cracks引入起点；the warning + is not issued ... until engineers compare, inspect, and confirm，用not...until表示形成正式警报的必要过程。
exp.other: crack 裂缝；structure 结构；hazard 危险；issue a warning 发布警报。
exp.meaning: 个人首次报告不等于正式被认可；由多个步骤进行独立评估并确认，才使主张具有可推广的效力。注意题目问required而非who noticed it first。
exp.rest: 报告更生动不能替代核验；给报告人荣誉不是警报成立条件；公众情绪不能替代工程检查。

questions.q: The interviewers first rated each applicant on a five-point scale. The scores were ______ combined with a written test result before the committee made its final decision.
o: ever
then
even
unless

exp.trans: 面试官先用五分制给申请者打分，随后将这些分数与笔试成绩合并，最后由委员会作出决定。
exp.structure: first标出初始步骤；The scores were then combined...是被动结构；before引出后续委员会决策，整个流程有清楚的先后顺序。
exp.other: rate 评分；scale 量表；written test 笔试；committee 委员会。
exp.meaning: then表示接着/随后；ever强调在任何时候或曾经；even强调甚至/出乎意料；在中性流程描述中then最精确。
exp.rest: ever不能自然表达流程先后；even无须强调出人意料的递进；unless引导条件从句，不能直接充当这个位置的流程副词。

questions.target: a judge / fearful of / soft on
questions.q: A judge, ______ of appearing too soft ______ repeat traffic offenders, imposed a fine after several earlier cases had ended with warnings. Which pair fits?
o: capable / in
fearful / on
fond / to
thoughtless / for

exp.trans: 一名法官担心自己显得对屡次违反交通法规的人过于宽容，在前几宗案件仅予以警告后，对下一名违规者罚了款。
exp.structure: A judge是名词主语；fearful of appearing...是修饰judge的形容词短语；imposed是谓语；after从句交代之前的处置。
exp.other: judge 法官/判断；offender 违法者；impose a fine 处以罚款；warning 警告。
exp.meaning: judge在a judge中是可数名词法官，不是动词判断；be fearful of doing sth.为担心做某事；be soft on sth./sb.为对违规行为或人处罚宽松。
exp.rest: capable of不表示忧虑且soft in不合习惯；fond of是喜欢显得宽容而非担心，soft to不合搭配；thoughtless不能表达后文处罚动机。

questions.q:
After years in the sunlight, only a faint line remained on the old map.
这里 faint 最接近哪种意思？
o: 神圣的
突然出现的
隐约的、不清晰的
故意伪造的

exp.trans: 经过多年日晒，旧地图上只剩下一条隐约可见的线。
exp.structure: After years in the sunlight是时间背景。only a faint line（主语）+ remained（不及物谓语）；on the old map是地点状语。
exp.other: sunlight 阳光；remain 留下、仍然存在；line 线条；after years 多年之后。
exp.meaning: faint在这里是微弱、不明显的；与faint praise中赞扬力度很弱具有相近的语义核心。
exp.rest: 神圣的常用holy/sacred；圣人是saint，不是faint。突然出现的可说sudden，重点是发生速度，不是清晰度。伪造的可说forged/fake，描述真伪，原句没有这种信息。

cloze-conditional-contrast.q: In theory, each grant application was judged only on its own merits. The audit later revealed that reviewers were influenced by earlier applications, so the evidence showed ______.
o: likewise
otherwise
meanwhile
therefore

exp.trans: 理论上，每份资助申请应只按自身质量评审；审计却发现评委受到之前申请的影响，所以证据表明实际情况并非如此。
exp.structure: In theory提出预期；The audit later revealed...给出相反事实；the evidence showed otherwise里的otherwise代替‘与理论预测不同’的情形。
exp.other: grant application 资助申请；merit 优点/实际价值；reviewer 评审员；reveal 揭示。
exp.meaning: otherwise在show/prove/suspect ... otherwise中常表示事实与此前观点不同；不只是‘此外’。
exp.rest: likewise表示同样，不能表达相反；meanwhile强调同时发生而非反证；therefore虽表因果，却不说明前述理论为何被推翻。

relative.q:
The archive contains several letters. The historian based her argument on those letters.
最自然的合并是：
o: The archive contains several letters on which the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which on the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters on that the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which the historian based her argument on them.

diag.1: 介词 on 应放在关系代词 which 前，不能写 which on the historian...
diag.2: 介词后不能用关系代词 that；应使用 which。
diag.3: which 已经代替 those letters，后面再用 them 造成重复。

exp.trans: 这个档案馆收藏着几封信，历史学家正是依据这些信件提出了她的论证。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：The historian based her argument on those letters. → those letters 变成先行词 several letters，并用 which 代替：the letters which the historian based her argument on → 正式写法把介词前置：the letters on which the historian based her argument。
exp.other: archive 档案馆；historian 历史学家；base A on B 以B为依据建立A；argument 论证/观点。
exp.meaning: 介词 + which 用于物；介词来自原简单句中的搭配 base A on B。
exp.rest: 介词前置的正确句是 “letters on which ...”；把 which 放在 on 前、把 that 放在介词后，或在 which 后再保留 them，都会造成词序或关系词重复问题。

cloze-applicant-outcome.skill: 区分申请者结果与其本人决定
cloze-applicant-outcome.q: A scholarship committee, not the students, decides who receives funding. In theory, an applicant's ______ should not depend on which other candidate happened to be interviewed immediately before her.
o: success
decision
vision
complaint

exp.trans: 奖学金由评审委员会决定授予谁。理论上，申请者能否成功获得资助，不应取决于刚在她之前接受面试的其他候选人。
exp.structure: A scholarship committee ... decides是前句主干；后句an applicant's success是名词中心，should not depend on...交代不该受谁影响。
exp.other: funding 资助；candidate 候选人；committee 委员会；depend on 取决于。
exp.meaning: success of an applicant在录取或资助语境中可指申请成功；decision of an applicant通常是申请者自己做的决定，而此处决策权属于委员会。
exp.rest: decision会将委员会作出的录取决定错写成申请者自身的决定；vision和complaint与资助是否获批的结果都不相称。

example-claim-scope.target: 例子同样可以说明支持改革
example-claim-scope.skill: 不能靠团体行动推固定结论
example-claim-scope.q: An article argues that locally organized groups can sometimes help an unpopular policy get started. It describes a farmers' cooperative that trained volunteers and persuaded members to test a water-saving system, helping the trial begin on schedule. What is the role of this example?
o: It proves every member had opposed water conservation before joining.
It shows cooperatives necessarily control the national government.
It establishes that all unpopular policies eventually succeed.
It supports the claim that organized groups can facilitate policy implementation.

exp.trans: 文章认为地方组织有时能帮助不受欢迎的政策启动，随后举农民合作社培训志愿者、推动成员试用节水系统，使试验按时开展的例子。这个例子是在支持‘团体也能帮助政策落实’。
exp.structure: An article argues + that从句是主张；It describes...引出实例；helping the trial begin是实例中的实际结果。
exp.other: cooperative 合作社；facilitate 促进；implementation 落实；trial 试行。
exp.meaning: 例子支持的结论可以是促进改革，也可以是阻碍改革，取决于前后文。不要机械地把‘团体动员’与‘妨碍改革’绑定。
exp.rest: 成员加入前态度没有交代；合作社对国家政府的控制与本文无关；一次成功试行不能保证所有政策最终成功。

process-stage-role.target: 个人估计 vs 集体验证
process-stage-role.skill: 区分主张起点和取得认可所需条件
process-stage-role.q: An analyst estimates that the city has room for 4,000 people in emergency shelters. Officials will use this figure for evacuation plans only after independent teams verify the counts and agree on a common estimate. What makes the figure suitable for official planning?
o: The analyst's personal familiarity with the shelters.
Verification and agreement across independent teams.
The public release of a large numerical estimate.
The analyst's decision to avoid revising the original number.

exp.trans: 一位分析员估计城市应急避难所可容纳4000人；只有独立团队核查数据并就统一估计达成一致，政府才会在疏散计划中采用这一数字。
exp.structure: An analyst + estimates + that从句提出最初主张；Officials + will use + this figure ... only after ...，only after指出主张转化为官方依据所需的条件。
exp.other: emergency shelter 应急避难所；evacuation 疏散；estimate 估计；verify 核验。
exp.meaning: 题干问的是让一项初步主张获得认可所需要的机制。个人估计是起点，独立团队核查与达成一致是条件；不能因为看到analyst就选个人经验。
exp.rest: 个人熟悉情况只能解释估计如何产生；数字公开和规模大都不能自动证明可靠；拒绝修订反而与核查机制相冲突。

cloze-time-adverbs.target: ever vs even / 曾经与甚至
cloze-time-adverbs.q: Have you ______ attended a blind-review workshop? Surprisingly, the university ______ invited first-year students to participate. Choose the best pair.
o: even / ever
then / even
ever / even
ever / then

exp.trans: 你曾经参加过匿名评审工作坊吗？令人意外的是，学校甚至邀请大一学生参与。
exp.structure: Have you ... attended是现在完成时疑问句；ever修饰attended；Surprisingly在后句提供意外语气，even修饰invited强调连大一学生也被邀请。
exp.other: blind review 匿名评审；workshop 工作坊；first-year student 大一学生；participate 参与。
exp.meaning: ever表示曾经/在任何时候，与现在完成时常见；even表示甚至/连……也，强调程度或意外，两者不可互换。
exp.rest: 把even放在曾经参加的时间提问位置、把ever放在甚至邀请的位置，均改变原意；then只表示随后，不能表达意外程度。

cloze-legal-stance.target: soft on / 表现得太宽容
cloze-legal-stance.q: The principal was afraid of appearing too soft on repeated cheating, so she enforced the stated penalty instead of issuing another warning. What was the principal worried about?
o: Whether the rules would make exams too difficult.
Whether the teacher had completed enough paperwork.
Whether she lacked the authority to open the school.
Whether others would think she treated repeated cheating too leniently.

exp.trans: 校长害怕别人认为她对屡次作弊过于宽容，于是按照规定执行处罚，而没有继续警告。
exp.structure: The principal was afraid of...是主干；appearing too soft on repeated cheating说明担心被如何看待；so引出后续处罚行动。
exp.other: principal 校长；cheating 作弊；enforce 执行；penalty 处罚。
exp.meaning: appearing too soft on是显得对某事态度过于宽松；afraid of/fearful of说明心理担忧，而不是有能力或喜欢宽容。
exp.rest: 试卷难度、教师手续和是否有开门的权力都不能解释‘担心显得过于宽容’与执行惩罚的关系。

faint.q: After a two-hour presentation, Maya said, “Well, at least the slides were readable.” Her remark is best described as:
o: faint praise
earnest approval
open hostility
sufficient evidence

diag.1: earnest approval 是真诚而明确的赞许；“at least...”只给了很弱的一点肯定。
diag.2: 这句话并非直接敌意攻击，而是非常有限、勉强的表扬。
diag.3: evidence 是“证据”，不是评价语气。

exp.trans: 听完一场两小时的演讲后，Maya 说：“嗯，至少幻灯片还看得清。”这句话最适合形容为“勉强的赞扬”。
exp.structure: Maya（主语）+ said（谓语）+ 引语（内容）。问句 Her remark is best described as... 中 is described是被动谓语，不是is加形容词表语。引语主干为the slides were readable；at least限制了肯定的力度。
exp.other: presentation 演讲/展示；readable 易读的；remark 评论；at least 至少。
exp.meaning: faint praise = 勉强的、力度很弱的赞扬。这里 faint 的核心是“微弱的、不强的”。
exp.rest: earnest approval = 真诚、明确的赞成，语气过强；open hostility = 公开敌意，不符合；sufficient evidence = 充分证据，词义类别都不对。只有 faint praise（力度很弱的赞扬）符合 at least 的保留语气。

faint.q:
Calling the volunteers' six-month restoration project “not entirely useless” struck the team as faint praise.
哪句改写最准确？
o: The team heard an enthusiastic celebration of the project.
The comment offered only a very weak form of approval.
The comment proved that the project had failed completely.
The team was told that the project had won an award.

exp.trans: 把志愿者历时六个月的修复项目说成“并非完全没有用”，让团队觉得这只是很勉强的赞扬。
exp.structure: Calling the volunteers' six-month restoration project ‘not entirely useless’是整个动名词短语主语；struck是谓语；the team是宾语；as faint praise表示给团队留下何种印象。短语内部call A B：称A为B。
exp.other: restoration 修复；entirely 完全；strike sb as sth 给某人以某种印象；approval 赞许。
exp.meaning: faint praise并非赞扬完全不存在，而是肯定得很有限，甚至暗含保留意见。
exp.rest: enthusiastic celebration表示热情赞颂，力度过强；had failed completely表示彻底失败，把微弱肯定改成全面否定；had won an award表示获奖，原文没有提供获奖事实。

article_session.source: 2013 英语一 Section I 完形填空
